definitions.explanation: Controlled substances such as heroin, cocaine, and opium. Used in legal, medical, and news contexts.
Used figuratively to describe something so appealing or habit-forming that it is hard to resist.

notes:
{麻薬|まやく} refers to narcotics and illegal drugs in general. A compound of {麻|ま} (hemp, numbness) + {薬|やく} (drug, medicine).

COMPOUNDS:
- {麻薬|まやく}{取締法|とりしまりほう}: Narcotics Control Act
- {麻薬|まやく}⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧: drug addiction
- {麻薬|まやく}⟦{密売|みつばい}→密売：22415_mitsubai⟧: drug trafficking
- {麻薬|まやく}⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧: drug investigation
- {麻薬|まやく}⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: drug dealing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薬物|やくぶつ}→薬物：14053_yakubutsu⟧: drugs, substances (broader, includes legal drugs used illegally)
- {覚醒剤|かくせいざい}: stimulant drugs (methamphetamine)
- ⟦ドラッグ→ドラッグ：28814_doraggu⟧: drugs (loanword, casual)
